# Benchmark Quality Checklist: Memory Quality Benchmarks

**Purpose**: Review whether P0.1 requirements are complete, unambiguous, measurable, authority-safe, and reproducible before release-gate implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all required memory-quality dimensions named and tied to an output metric or explicit unavailable state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the four execution profiles and their availability/failure behaviors fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Are both the LongMemEval input boundary and Mem0 external-result boundary defined without requiring third-party data in the base gate? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012–FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the distinction between candidate retrieval, authorized context preparation, and proven injection unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the meaning of unknown, not applicable, skipped, failed, and passed distinct for every metric/profile? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 Is “fair comparison” defined by an explicit set of matching identities rather than a subjective judgment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do optional hosted/local-model requirements remain consistent with the offline, dependency-free release-gate requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Do the scoring requirements consistently preserve AtMem as authority before and after intelligence components? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010–FR-011; Constitution I]
- [ ] CHK009 Do publication requirements require direct per-metric and overall comparison outcomes without hiding mixed results or inventing an arbitrary weighted score? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014–FR-015]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Are absolute safety thresholds and checked-in non-regression floors separately measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Can deterministic repeatability be evaluated without requiring timestamps and duration to be byte-identical? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001; Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Can every aggregate metric be traced back to stable case-level expected and observed outcomes? [Traceability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are positive and negative scenarios required for each deterministic benchmark category? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK014 Are malformed, duplicate, unsupported, unavailable-provider, and timeout states addressed without silent omission? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are no-answer, related-but-non-answering, cross-scope, lifecycle-ineligible, and instruction-poisoning cases explicitly covered? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional and Dependency Requirements

- [ ] CHK016 Are secret minimization, bounded diagnostics, and avoidance of unnecessary private content specified for all report types? [Privacy, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK017 Are Python compatibility, zero base-dependency change, and no persistent-schema change constraints explicit? [Dependency, Spec §FR-018; Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK018 Are model identity, usage, price source, environment, dataset digest, and configuration complete enough to reproduce both quality and cost comparisons? [Reproducibility, Spec §FR-006, §FR-015]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state but does not modify markers.
- Add comments or findings inline.
